listing.pageText:
Universal USB-C Power Delivery 3.0 (PD) Laptop Charger
This Monoprice 65W USB-C charger delivers fast, universal charging power up to 65 watts via the Power Delivery 3.0 standard. It's compact and lightweight, making it an excellent replacement or secondary charger for a wide array of USB-C powered devices, including laptops, tablets, and smartphones. It features a built-in 2.6-foot USB-C cable and includes essential safety features like overcurrent and overheating protection circuits, being ETL Certified for reliability. It is capable of fast charging a 13" MacBook Pro in under two hours or bringing an iPhone to 55% in about 30 minutes.
• Up to 65W USB Type‑C® Power Delivery (PD)
• Fast Charging for wide range of devices, including phones, tablets, and laptops
• Built‑in 2.6‑foot USB‑C® cable for fast charging right out of the box
• Compact and lightweight brick design
• Universally compatible with all USB‑C devices, regardless of manufacturer or brand
• Features overcurrent and overheating protection circuits and is ETL Certified for safety
• Detachable 4.5-foot grounded AC power cord

Soundcore Space One are over-ear wireless headphones featuring adaptive active noise cancellation that automatically adjusts to block out surroundings in real-time. They are equipped with 40mm dynamic drivers for rich sound and deep bass, and support LDAC for Hi-Res Wireless audio. The headphones offer a long battery life of up to 40 hours with ANC on (55 hours with ANC off) and feature fast charging. Designed for comfort, they include rotating ear cups with memory foam and a flexible headband. Additional features include voice-targeting microphones for clear calls, five levels of transparency mode, smart wearing detection, and multipoint pairing for seamless switching between devices.
